margin: Fixed non-label runner-up at each reference model; relative change divided by max(original signed margin,0.1*median positive margin). Reference-correct calibration samples only enter each objective. g averages signed beta derivatives, including beta chain scaling; c is negative inverse native-margin Gram times g, rescaled once to fixed caps.
